name: multi-agent-role-work
description: Keeps long-running project work aligned with the user's goal while handling delivery rigor internally.

interface.shortDescription: Keeps every change aligned with your goal.
interface.longDescription: Describe what you want to achieve and Project Compass keeps that goal visible across follow-up questions, fixes, testing, and delivery. It checks runtime and project-state continuity before changes, archives replaced documents away from the current baseline, runs machine-observable QA before asking for acceptance, calls out changes that could shift the outcome, and asks only for decisions that matter. Delivery mechanics stay in the background unless you explicitly ask for technical diagnostics.
capabilities: Shows whether the project is still on track
Checks runtime and project-state continuity before edits
Flags changes that could shift the outcome
Asks before meaningful goal or scope changes
Makes previews and results easy to inspect
Checks the final result against the goal
Runs machine-observable QA before user acceptance
Archives superseded documents without losing history
Surfaces only decisions that need the user
defaultPrompt: 继续推进当前项目，先告诉我有没有偏离目标
检查当前项目是否仍然围绕目标推进
